title: Total weekly movement tracked with lower risk.
axis_title: LOWER RISK OF DYING VS INACTIVE

statement.detail: Pooled results across cohort studies — weekend-pattern movers had lower death rates from any cause and from cancer.

_provenance.finding: mvpa · weekend warrior equivalence · confidence 0.65 · 22 studies

claims.paper: doi:10.1016_j.puhe.2025.105977 · Kim et al. 2025, Public Health, systematic review and meta-analysis
claims.quote: Lower risks were observed for all-cause mortality (Weekend warrior: relative risk (RR) 0.76, 95 % confidence interval (CI) 0.66-0.87; Regular physical activity: RR 0.71, 95 % CI 0.63-0.80)
